dz: 20岁的布列塔尼公爵弗朗西斯在岳父路易十二去世后继承了法国王位.
de: Twenty-year-old Francis, Duke of Brittany, succeeds to the French throne following the death of his father-in-law, Louis XII.

dz: 法兰西一世的加冕仪式在雷姆斯大教堂举行,新君主被克洛维斯所取出油膏并被查理曼之剑所取出.
de: Coronation of Francis I of France takes place at Reims Cathedral, where the new monarch is anointed with the oil of Clovis and girt with the sword of Charlemagne.
